summary: On June 13, 2026, Keenova Therapeutics plc (Ireland-based, formerly Mallinckrodt) filed an 8-K to disclose a definitive agreement to sell its Percocet and Endocet opioid businesses to Par Health, Inc. for total expected consideration of ~$250 million, comprising an upfront cash purchase price of $25 million (subject to customary cash/debt/working capital adjustments) plus quarterly earnout payments over five years based on the business's gross profit. The board's recommendation is not stated; no advisor named. Closing is expected in Q3 2026, conditioned on HSR Act clearance. Post-close, Keenova will exit the opioid market entirely. Watch for regulatory review duration and earnout-performance risk.
